item.text: {"rule":"The observations are insufficient to infer the procedure. In the repeated trials, the first choice kept the ace of hearts and ace of clubs; in most trials, tapping the ace of hearts kept it, but in one trial tapping the ace of clubs discarded it and the ace of hearts still remained. The final card may therefore have been determined independently of the last tap, or by some unobserved rule."}
